_comment: Descent flags for cell s0b (Quail corpus, Italian, seed 0, mass-weighted). These are the method flags of the measured run; paths and private execution options are omitted. Every key maps to one flag of engraft.descend_corpus: the top-level keys by name (census -> --census, fact_weight -> --fact-weight, ...), the nested stop_criterion as --stop-criterion/--stop-local-window/--stop-phi/--stop-persistence, and tuning_constants as --mu/--lr-scale. 'cell' and 'production_note' are labels, not flags.

tuning_constants._comment: Given, not derived: produced by a calibration procedure that is not part of this release.

production_note: The measured run used a faster private execution path for the mixture-of-experts layers (grouped expert kernel, mixed-precision head, compiled fusions) that is not published. The public reference path runs the same descent with --moe-kernel per_expert and no fusion; the two expert kernels give bit-identical logits, and the fusion pass changes the distillation loss by about 2e-3 (measured). See docs/formats.md.
